methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Maglut Heavy Industries is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Azhar Yerzhanova and Curtis Wu. The valuation analysis draws from a broader peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector.

A peer-median approach was not applicable to this analysis. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains 10 comparable companies, but filtering by same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any filtered category. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial noise given the wide dispersion in business models and capital requirements across robotics subsegments. This constraint reflects the relatively thin population of pre-seed stage robotics companies with sufficient disclosure for direct comparison.

Without sufficient narrow-peer triangulation, a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the data provided. Any estimate at this stage would require either: (i) expansion to adjacent stages and acceptance of higher methodological uncertainty, (ii) fundamental build-up modeling using management projections and sector benchmarks, or (iii) additional transaction comps from recent pre-seed rounds in the peer set. The team's relevant operational experience (ex-Nohbo, ex-Material Impact, HBS, Boeing, Amgen) is noted but does not substitute for quantitative valuation anchor points.
